title: Netatmo Weather Module Sync Gap Watch
dataSources: Weather-station observations (`ecowitt:obs`, `weatherflow:obs`), air-quality readings (`purpleair:aqi`, `airgradient:sensor`), soil-moisture/greenhouse sensors, aquarium controllers (`aquarium:sensor`).
app: Personal weather stations (Ecowitt/Ambient/Davis/WeatherFlow), air-quality sensors (PurpleAir/AirGradient), and aquarium/greenhouse/soil sensors via HEC and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=netatmo:weather
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by module_name
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| where hours_since>1
| sort - hours_since
description: Detects when Netatmo weather module data has stopped arriving for a given module.
value: Personal telemetry is only useful when it is current; sync-gap alerts catch failed exports and broken credentials early.
implementation: Track the latest event time per module and alert when the feed is older than 1 hours.
visualization: Table of entities by hours since last event.
grandmaExplanation: It gently when one part of your Netatmo weather module feed has stopped checking in and probably needs fixing.
